title: Credit for Days Spent on Payment Hold, Northgate+ Business
content:
**Rule.** Under the Business closure schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, days the business spent waiting for its most recent fee to settle are credited to the Business refund. The billing period is that of the most recent settled fee; the declined attempts are the declined fee attempts recorded on the membership ledger for that billing period; the days counted run from that period's start date through the day before the fee settled. The daily amount is the fee divided by 365.

| Declined attempts in that billing period | Credit added to the Business refund |
|---|---|
| two or more | each counted day at the daily amount multiplied by 1.0 |
| exactly one | each counted day at the daily amount multiplied by 0.5 |
| none | nothing |

The credit is added to the Business refund before the refund is capped at the fee, rounded down to the cent and floored at zero; it is not rounded on its own.

**Worked case (hypothetical fee 146.00, period starting 1 March 2032, fee settled 8 March 2032).** The counted days are 1 March through 7 March, 7 days; the daily amount is 146.00 divided by 365, that is 0.40. With two declined attempts the credit is 7 multiplied by 0.40, that is 2.80; with one declined attempt it is 1.40.
